tables.name: installation_meta
tables.purpose: Installation/key alias references and trusted clock anchors; no owner finance in clear

tables.name: owner_vaults
tables.purpose: Owner/workspace/device/capture epoch and credentials inside ciphertext; distinct DEK per vault; durable nonce counter outside ciphertext

tables.name: outbox_items
tables.purpose: Immutable normalized observation/binding/parser/event/revision/digest; local dates inside ciphertext authoritative

tables.name: capture_identities
tables.purpose: OS occurrence and last digest/revision; bounded index, not reliable bank identity

tables.name: upload_batches
tables.purpose: Immutable ordered item IDs/revisions/digests + exact semantic command; no retag after split/retry

tables.name: ack_replay
tables.purpose: Bounded normalized observation+durable ACK identity; never converted to pending automatically

tables.name: coverage_gaps
tables.purpose: No raw/money/source text; local uncertainty interval pending explicit server mapping

tables.name: auth_pending
tables.purpose: Rotation/revoke pending intent plus exact idempotency binding; replay lifetime from ARCH06

constraints: FK vault_id RESTRICT for every scoped table; explicit atomic vault delete only after cancellation/drain fence
UNIQUE vault_id+sequence for outbox; immutable encrypted observation tuple
AEAD nonce uniqueness per DEK enforced across all encrypted tables via repository nonce reservation; not merely table-local unique
Single batch transition/ACK transaction removes pending row only after valid durable ACK plus journal policy; lost ACK retries same semantic IDs
Indexes vault_id/state/sequence, expiration metadata, lookup_hmac; no financial plaintext indexes
Auth secrets are ciphertext; no automatic destructive Room migrations; versioned export schema + migration tests
